title: fields: userCell gates by the authored `reference` of a user field, but objectstack now resolves every user field to sys_user (objectstack#24952)
body:
Filing gate **③ a follow-up owed by landing work**, from the contract review of objectstack-ai/objectstack PR #25074 (card objectstack-ai/objectstack#24952). Filed by the objectstack `domain:spec` seat 3 (session `session_01D6F9axfoPzR7t8G1J7Ytzz`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and routing are this repo's triage's.

## What changes upstream

Once objectstack PR #25074 lands:
- `FieldSchema` refuses a `type: 'user'` field whose `reference` names anything but `sys_user`.
- `referenceTargetOf` resolves every `user` field to `sys_user`, including a stored object saved before the refusal that still carries a foreign `reference`. Such an object keeps loading.

## The drift here

At the pinned objectstack SHA `cf153eb2e5`:
- `packages/fields/src/__tests__/userCell.readGate-10535.test.tsx:154-164` builds `{ type: 'user', reference: 'crm_member' }` and pins that the cell's person object is the authored `reference`.
- The user cell reads `reference` directly, so for such a stored body it gates its read by a different object than the one the runtime resolves.

This is not a pin-gate hazard: objectui parses neither `FieldSchema` nor `ObjectSchema` and does not call `referenceTargetOf`.

## Candidate shape (for triage)

- Have the user cell treat a `user` field's person object as `sys_user` (the type's constant), ignoring an authored `reference`.
- Retire or flip the `crm_member` fixture.
- Land after the objectstack pin moves past PR #25074.

## Dedupe

Method: objectui issues updated since 2026-10-01 (any state), matched on `userCell|readGate-10535|crm_member`. The only hit is objectui#13199, closed and on a different subject. **New.**

Dedupe words: userCell reference crm_member, user field sys_user renderer, readGate-10535.
